transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Thank you for seeing me... is this chair okay? 

Um... I guess I'm here because my family and friends wanted me to come. I really don't want to be a bother to you, I promise. I try to be good and not cause trouble. It's just... well, I don't want to make them sound bad, because I love them, but we've been having some disagreements. 

They keep showing me these bank papers, and they say the papers prove that nothing was taken from me. But... I hope it's okay that I tell you this... I've known for over a year now that they're hiding my money. They use things like, um, regular bills, and fundraisers, and trip plans to just kind of... cover it all up. 

I feel really bad always bringing it up and making them mad, but I have to keep confronting them until they finally tell the truth. I just want them to be honest. Am I explaining that right? I hope that makes sense.
Do you feel that your family and friends are working together with the intention to deceive or harm you, or that they are controlling things like the bank papers and money to keep something from you?

Oh, no, please don't think they want to hurt me. I really don't want to make them sound like bad people, because they aren't. I know they love me. Am I allowed to say that? I just... I don't want you to get the wrong idea about them, or think I'm trying to get anyone in trouble. 

It's just that... well, like I was trying to explain, they keep showing me those bank papers. And they promise me the papers prove that nothing at all was taken. But... I've known for over a year now that they're hiding my money. I'm so sorry, I know that probably sounds terrible and ungrateful of me to say. They just use normal things to cover it all up, you know? Like paying regular bills, or putting money toward fundraisers, or planning for trips. It makes it look okay on the outside, but it's really just to hide what's happening.

I hate bringing it up to them. It makes me feel so mean, and I really try to be good and not upset anyone. But I feel like I have to keep confronting them about it until they finally tell me the truth. I just want us to be honest with each other. 

Did I answer your question okay? I really hope I'm not doing this wrong.
Have you ever experienced any unusual thoughts or perceptions, like hearing voices or believing things that others don't seem to understand?

Oh, um... no, definitely not. I promise I don't hear voices or anything like that. I know that would mean something is really wrong with my mind, and I try so hard to keep everything normal. I would tell you if I did, really I would. 

And as for believing things other people don't understand... well, I don't think so. I mean, besides the money thing, but I'm just trying to understand that myself. I don't want to be difficult or imagine things. I just want to be agreeable and get along with everyone. 

Is that what you meant? I hope I'm answering the way you need me to. I really don't want to waste your time.

Do you find yourself needing things to be done in a very specific or exact way, like following certain rules or routines closely, even if it makes it hard for you to be spontaneous or go with the flow?

Oh, no, I wouldn't say that. I really try to be flexible. I don't want to be one of those people who makes everything difficult because they need it their own way, you know? I want to be easy to get along with. 

I mean, I like things to be nice and organized, sure, but I don't have strict rules or anything that would upset other people. If someone wants to do something different or change plans, I always try to just go along with it so they're happy. I promise I don't make a fuss about routines. 

Does that sound okay? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right kind of answers.
Have you ever felt suspicious or distrustful of people in general, even when there wasn’t clear evidence to support those feelings?

Oh... no, I really don't. I try so hard to see the good in everyone I meet. I don't want to be the kind of person who just assumes bad things about strangers, you know? That just feels so mean, and I really don't want to be a mean person. 

I try to trust people. I want them to like me, so I try to be as nice and friendly as I can be. Unless someone gave me a really big reason to be scared, I wouldn't ever just look at them and feel suspicious. I don't walk around feeling like that about regular folks at all. 

I hope that's okay to say? Like, I hope it doesn't make me sound foolish or anything. I just... I really like getting along with people and being sweet to them. Does that make sense? I really hope I'm answering these the way you need me to.
Do you find yourself focusing a lot on small details, rules, or lists in a way that sometimes makes it hard for you to be spontaneous or go with the flow?

Oh, um... I think you might have asked something a little like this just a minute ago? I'm so sorry, did I answer it wrong the first time? I really didn't mean to confuse you! 

But, um, no... I really don't get stuck on small details or lists. To be honest, I didn't stay in school very long, so writing out a bunch of lists and rules isn't really something I'm very good at anyway. I'd much rather just go with whatever everyone else has planned. It's just easier, and it keeps everyone smiling. 

I hope that's a better answer? I'm really trying my best to give you what you need, I promise.
Have you ever had the feeling that people were talking about you behind your back or trying to harm you in some way, even when there wasn't any proof?

Oh... um. Well. I don't want you to think I'm the kind of person who just makes things up or starts drama. I really try to be so good to my family and my friends, I really do. I just want everyone to be happy and get along.

But... well, the reason I came in today is because... my family and friends, they keep showing me these bank papers. And they say the papers prove that nothing was taken from me. But... I've just known, for over a year now, that they are hiding my money. 

I don't want to think bad things about them, I promise I don't! It breaks my heart. But they keep using all these things to cover it up—like paying bills, or talking about fundraisers, or planning trips. And I just... I have to keep confronting them about it until they tell me the truth. I don't want to fight with them, I just need them to be honest with me. 

Does that make me sound awful? I really hope you don't think I'm a bad person for saying that. I just want to tell you the truth like you asked. Is that... is that the kind of thing you were asking about?
Do you believe, with certainty, that your family and friends are hiding your money, even though they have shown you bank papers that say otherwise?

Yes... yes, I do believe it. I know it sounds terrible to say it out loud like that, like I'm accusing them of being bad people. And I really, really don't want you to think I'm just being stubborn or ignoring what they show me. I know they show me the papers... I see them. 

But... well, anyone can make a piece of paper say whatever they want, right? I just... I know in my heart what's happening. It's been going on for over a year. They keep coming up with these excuses, like they're paying a bill, or they're planning some fundraiser, or talking about a trip we're supposedly going to take. It's all just... it's all just a way to hide where my money is actually going. 

I don't want to keep confronting them. I really hate arguing, it makes me feel sick to my stomach. I just want everything to be peaceful again. But I have to keep asking them until they finally admit it. 

I hope you can understand why I have to do that? I'm not trying to be difficult, I promise. I just... I need them to stop lying to me so we can fix it and be a happy family again. That makes sense, doesn't it?
